name: P1 applicability is never asked, so a QB is blamed on the data file
aimed_at: T1 a QB is not told the file is missing a column that is not about him

name: P2 every position is receiving-eligible, so nothing is ever inapplicable
P3 no position is receiving-eligible, so a back loses his target share
aimed_at: T6 a receiving back is measured, not gated away

name: P4 a blank position is ruled inapplicable rather than left undecided
aimed_at: T7 a blank position claims nothing

name: P5 the sentence names a position it was not given
aimed_at: T4 a kicker is not handed the quarterback's sentence, T12 the builder
old: `Not a statistic about a ${position}: ${why}. This is a fact about the position, `
new: `Not a statistic about a QB: ${why}. This is a fact about the position, `

name: P6 the sentence stops saying it is not a gap in the data
aimed_at: T2 a fact about the position
new: + 'and the usage rows on file for this season do not carry it.';

name: P7 the positional absence is labelled as an ordinary missing measurement
aimed_at: T14 the service marks which kind of absence each one is

name: P8 every absence is labelled positional, so the kind means nothing
aimed_at: T14 a receiver's missing column is not a positional absence

name: P9 a measured stat is stamped with a kind of absence
aimed_at: T14 a measured stat carries no absence label
old: ({ key, label, value, unit, basis, unavailable_reason: null, unavailable_kind: null });
new: ({ key, label, value, unit, basis, unavailable_reason: null, unavailable_kind: 'not_measured' });

name: P10 the routes stats go back to the paid-source sentence for everyone
aimed_at: T1 the routes half of the positional gate
new: const routes = (key, label, unit) => absent(key, label, UNAVAILABLE.routes, { unit });

name: P11 red-zone share is gated on position too
aimed_at: T9 red-zone share stays a platform absence for every position
new:
applies === false
        ? inapplicable('red_zone_share', 'Red-zone share', position, { unit: 'pct' })
        : absent('red_zone_share', 'Red-zone share', UNAVAILABLE.redZone, { unit: 'pct' })

name: P12 applicability is asked after the data, so an idle QB is blamed on his rows
aimed_at: T3 the same position gets the same sentence, busy or idle

name: P13 the panel pools both absences under one heading
aimed_at: T13 the panel separates the two kinds of absence

name: P14 the panel groups by reading the sentence instead of the label
aimed_at: T13, T14 grouping by prose is the failure the kind field removes
new:
const absent = report.stats.filter(s => s.value == null
    && !/Not a statistic about/.test(s.unavailable_reason ?? ''));

name: C1 control: a comment reworded, nothing behavioural
aimed_at: nothing — this row is DESIGNED to survive
old: * The positions a pass can be thrown to. Target share, WOPR and anything built
new: * The positions a pass may be thrown to. Target share, WOPR and anything built

name: C2 control: an anchor that does not exist
aimed_at: nothing — this row is DESIGNED to be reported NOT APPLIED

name: C3 control: an anchor that matches more than once
aimed_at: nothing — this row is DESIGNED to be reported NOT APPLIED, on count
